sections.description: Includes PubMed publication lists via the official NCBI E-utilities API (cached, with admin alarm mail). Collections are managed under "Beiträge > PubMed (KornSW)": [include_pubmed collection="64421242"]
sections.changelog:
Version 1.4.0

  • **New Feature:** the hit list in the admin page shows how PubMed interpreted the search filter (query translation, total hit count, warnings about ignored phrases or unknown fields), to find out why e.g. a `NOT` does not take effect.
